_comment: The one service that does not run through tsx. decile-mcp is an MCP server
compiled to dist/ and started with `node dist/server.js`, so it differs
from its ten siblings on exactly one axis: it emits.
Everything on the shared axis — target, lib, strict, esModuleInterop,
skipLibCheck, types — comes from tsconfig.services.json and is no longer a
second copy. The overrides below are the emit/module axis and nothing else.
NodeNext (not the base's ESNext/bundler) because the output is executed
directly by node, which needs real extension-bearing specifiers resolved
the way node resolves them — not the way a bundler would.
